newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran to hang "Tehran vampire" on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Iran to hang "Tehran vampire" on Wednesday.

text.p: An Iranian taxi-driver dubbed the "Tehran vampire" will be executed on Wednesday for murdering nine girls and women, state-run Tehran radio said on Monday.
It quoted a judicial official as saying Gholamreza Khoshrou Kouran Kordieh, 28, would be hanged after the Supreme Court upheld a lower court's decision to impose nine death sentences.
Khoshrou confessed on television to kidnapping, raping and murdering nine girls and women over a four-month period earlier this year. The youngest was 10 years old.
Newspaper reports said Khoshrou would be hanged from a crane in public near the scene of the murders, Shahrak Rah-Ahan in Tehran's western suburbs.
Relatives of the victims had demanded during the trial that he be stoned to death.
Khoshrou, dubbed "the Tehran vampire" because he murdered by night, was reported to have burned the bodies of his victims so they would not be identified.
